subject.title: fix(agents): drop stale internal orphan prompts

question: Should OpenClaw solve the canonical stale orphan prompt bug by dropping selected internal orphan leaves in this PR, or by preserving orphaned user text as context through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759?
rationale: Both open PRs target the same issue but encode different session-state semantics, and this external PR also lacks real embedded-agent proof for its drop/preserve split.

options.title: Pick the proof-positive preserve-as-context path
options.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759 as the canonical candidate and keep this PR paused or close it only after that direction is accepted.

options.title: Keep this focused drop strategy
options.body: Require redacted embedded-agent runtime logs or terminal output proving the stale internal drop and `sessions_send` preserve cases before considering merge.

options.title: Request a narrower predicate
options.body: Ask for a reduced source-tool rule if not all six internal handoff tools should be removed from repaired prompts with fresh user input.

recommendation.title: Pick the proof-positive preserve-as-context path
recommendation.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759 as the canonical candidate and keep this PR paused or close it only after that direction is accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is closest to the queued-user prompt preservation invariant introduced in PR 65478 and the recent embedded-runner helper history.
